overview: Tradenest Naturals manufactures spray dried blackberry powder for global food and beverage formulations. Produced in India through precise spray drying, this ingredient captures the deep color and characteristic tart sweetness of fresh fruit. As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain high standards across our 6-step production process, delivering reliable bulk ingredients to global markets.

Our dehydrated blackberry powder features fine particle consistency and rapid solubility in liquids. With moisture kept below five percent, it delivers shelf stability of 18 to 24 months. We support commercial buyers with consistent bulk supply, OEM solutions, private labeling, and complete export documentation. Flexible packaging options ensure ingredients arrive protected and ready for commercial manufacturing.
highlights: Spray dried for high solubility and smooth dispersion
Fine particle consistency between 80 to 100 mesh
Low moisture content under 5 percent for extended stability
Long shelf life of 18 to 24 months
Manufactured through a disciplined 6-step production process
Sourced and processed in India with minimum order quantity of 5 Kg
applications: Instant fruit drink premixes and beverage blends
Confectionery items including gummies and hard candies
Bakery fillings, glazes, and decorative frostings
Dairy products such as flavored yogurts and ice creams
Dessert toppings, fruit syrups, and fruit sauces
Dry seasoning blends and snack food coatings

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating both initial formulation trials and full commercial production.

faqs.q: What packaging formats do you offer for bulk buyers?
faqs.a: We provide 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Can we request samples prior to commercial orders?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to assist with research, development, and trial batches.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label services?
faqs.a: Yes, we support OEM manufacturing, private labeling, and can provide custom mesh sizes or custom packaging on request.

faqs.q: What are the recommended storage conditions and shelf life?
faqs.a: The product has a shelf life of 18 to 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide support for international export procedures?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide export documentation support to facilitate smooth shipping and customs clearance.
